notes.title: SCROOMAGE DEMO 2.0 UPDATE
notes.content:
The final major update for the SCROOMAGE Demo is FINALLY HERE!
It's been a bit more than a month since the last update released, and we've gotten a ton of feedback since then. That update was to fix some major issues that cropped up right away, but this one will change the game significantly. Here's a list of all the major changes:

[b]PERFORMANCE ,BUG FIXES & GENERAL CHANGES[/b]
[list]
[*]Framerate has been [b]significantly[/b] improved by optimizing collision geometry.
[*]The player no longer jitters on the ground after moving in certain ways.
[*]Items like the health pickups and keys will be used immediately upon grabbing to make them less confusing to use.
[*]Every usable item now has a unique label that describes what will happen upon using the item.
[*]The low health overlay isn't as visible at higher health values.
[/list]

[b]BALANCE[/b]
[list]
[*]Scroomguy's slide has been buffed significantly.
[*]Every enemy has had their health slightly reduced.
[*]The punch now has a faster cooldown and higher range.
[*]Many small balance changes to all the weapons.
[/list]

[b]VISUALS[/b]
[list]
[*]An easing animation has been added to crouching.
[*]Enemies have been given thick outlines to help improve visibility
[*]You can now give enemies coloured tints to improve visibility by changing the hue slider in the settings
[*]New swaying improvements were added to jumping, sliding, and recoil
[*]You can now disable ambient occlusion
[*]You can now limit the framerate. This will help for players who get inconsistent framerates in game.
[*]You can adjust the time it takes for blood decals to despawn.
[*]New particle effects were added to gun shots. Blood will spray from enemies and debris clouds will fly out of walls.
[/list]

[b]NEW CONTENT[/b]
[list]
[*]A new bootcamp level with a basic tutorial, a shooting range, and a deathmatch pit has been added.
[*]The Electric 9, a burst fire pistol, has been added to the game.
[*]The Revolver, a sniper pistol in previous builds of the game, has been re-added to the demo.
[*]The car has been reworked. It is now a manual transmission vehicle.
[/list]

If you don't see the update show up, right click on your game in the steam library, go to properties, then installed files, and press "Verify integrity of demo files".

That's it for now! Have fun with the update, and if you manage to find one of those once in a [i]fortnight[/i] collision issues, let us know on our twitter @SCROOMAGE!

notes.title: SCROOMAGE DEMO Update 1.1
notes.content:
[h1]WOW[/h1]

First off, I'm BLOWN AWAY at how many of you have been playing and enjoying the demo! I also very much appreciate all the feedback you've given us, because without it I would've been so out of touch!

Anyway, there's a few major issues that have caused some of you trouble, so I got this update out as fast as I could.
[b]This demo will create a new save file with new properties, so you will lose your previous settings![/b]
[list]
[*] The email menu on the title screen should now work for all screen resolutions
[*] There is now a red overlay that indicates low health.
[*] Grenades now have a red outline to try and improve visibility
[*] Getting stuck on top of the computer in the main menu is now fixed.
[*] You can now turn off or adjust the visual recoil for the weapons.
[*] For speed runners, you can toggle a new option that replaces the money counter that shows a live timer and the money earned in the level.
[*] Pressing R in the menu will now restart the level.
[*] The use prompt should disappear more consistently
[*] In Gone Fishin', the escape prompt now correctly tells the player to run to the helipad.
[/list]

There's still a lot of work to do, and I'll make sure the demo gets updated to be the best it can, but for now this should address some of the biggest problems besides the optimization.
[b]If you don't see the update show up, right click on your game in the steam library, go to properties, then installed files, and press "Verify integrity of demo files".[/b]

notes.title: SCROOMAGE DEMO OUT TOMORROW
notes.content:
[h1]THATS RIGHT[/h1]
THE DEMO'S COMING OUT [b]TOMORROW[/b] FOR THE NEXT FEST EVENT!

The demo includes two full levels and a sandbox mode where you can mess around with any of the content seen in the demo. There's also a hard mode that amps up the intensity a bunch, so I hope this demo's gonna last you for a while!
I also encourage all of you to send in feedback or bug reports by using the button in the pause menu. Your help will be greatly appreciated!
Just so you all know, the demo is going to stay up even after the next fest ends, so if you don't have time to play right now, don't worry!

Fill up the floors with blood, smoke some cigarettes, rack up your combos, and most importantly, have some FUN.

SEE YOU ALL TOMORROW.
